text: A running key is a long text written under the message, one letter per place. Here the text is K1's carved letters, started at its 49th letter, the alignment that came closest.
Even the best alignment gets only 8 of the 24 known places right; chance gives about that many when 165,216 alignments are tried.
Every offset of K1, K2 and K3, carved and solved, forwards and backwards, under all 24 ways of using the table: 0 survivors.
